title: 第9章 又一次痛苦的进化第10章 黑豹与巴迪
slug: 性转狐狸开局就被抓走了
content_zh:
在这25天的狩猎旅程中，艾可从未轻易与超出自己能力范围的猎物正面交锋，他总是选择伏击，这是他的生存之道。尽管如此，他偶尔也会挑衅一些敌人，然后巧妙地利用“洞穴挖掘”技能遁入地下，迷惑对手，再出其不意地将它们击杀。这不仅是他提升等级的绝佳方法，也是他生存的策略。
那晚，他再次激活了“疾跑”。他将耐力管理得恰到好处，总是保持在满格状态，这让他成功地将“耐力恢复”提升到了3级。
艾可也费尽心思将“生命值恢复”提升到了4级。这是他在这段充满挑战的旅程中，经历了无数次生死攸关的时刻，很多时候都是因为他过于自信。一次山体滑坡让他的生命值濒临枯竭，那是他第一次真切感受到生命值低下带来的严重影响。他的身体变得异常沉重，反应迟缓，伤口让他极度虚弱。至于耐力，那种感觉就像一直处于无法喘息的梦魇中，极大地削弱了他的行动效率和身体协调性。因此，他总是竭尽全力保持满生命值和耐力，再也不想重温那种令人恐惧的感觉。
然而，真正让他感到沮丧的是，自从离开村庄后，他的等级就像陷入了泥潭，始终停滞不前，目前仍然停留在100级。似乎他必须去猎杀更强大的野兽，才有可能打破这一僵局，进一步实现升级。
尽管如此，这些艰难困苦最终还是得到了应有的回报，因为他距离成功只剩下几天的时间。在森林里的这段漫长时光里，他还敏锐地注意到森林变得日益躁动不安，期间他好几次邂逅了伙伴。
每次看到伙伴和它的同伴，它们总是遍体鳞伤、疲惫不堪。受伤最少的总是那只黑豹，但从它那独特的皮毛判断，它可能也是个暗影猎手，这使得它能够巧妙地避免正面冲突，与那些直接面对敌人的同伴相比，受到的伤害自然较少。
……
他又美滋滋地吃了些蛋，然后迈着轻快的步伐回到了自己的洞穴。他惊喜地意识到他的“洞穴挖掘”技能竟能让地面变得松软，这样一来，他挖掘的时候就能够更加轻松地把土“挪开”。这一发现对于他的挖掘工作无疑是如虎添翼。他可以先施展“洞穴挖掘”软化地面，然后用锋利的爪子“铲”开。
艾可惬意地躺在他不断扩大了的洞穴里。然而，一丝担忧却悄然爬上心头，他担心如果进化让他的身体变大太多，自己会不会被困在这狭小的空间里。
艾可缓缓躺下来，耐心地等待着倒计时终于结束。结束后他打算去猎取些新鲜的食物。消化这些蛋大概需要半天到两天的时间，而且他即便三天不进食也不会有太大问题。附近就有水源，所以饮水不是问题，但即便如此，他要是五天不喝水那也是万万不行的。不过他可不想……
……
[开始进化过程：[暗影耳廓狐]-0天0小时1分钟]
进化的时刻即将来临。他心急如焚地等待着，额头上不禁冒出了细密的汗珠。他留意到像“减少疼痛”或“增加疼痛耐受性”之类的技能选项……但它们的价格实在是贵得令人咋舌。
艾可无奈之下，只能咬咬牙准备硬扛这种撕心裂肺的痛苦。
[进化正在进行]
“啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！”
当那奇怪的声音在耳边响起，他瞬间就被难以忍受的疼痛折磨得大脑一片空白。
-100生命值
“在黑暗中很好，对吧？你可以杀死任何你想杀的东西，没人能找到你~”
“做女性很愉快，他们那么宠爱你，当你足够漂亮时，他们甚至崇拜你。想象一下，所有人都听你指挥~”

“只要把进入你领地的人都杀了就好，毕竟，这是你的！”
“你应该享受你的美丽，建立一个后宫，这样你就不需要自己去狩猎，只需等待美味多汁的肉送到你面前~”
“你应该扩大你的领地，这样你就可以继续狩猎！狩猎永不停息！”
-100生命值
有各种奇怪的噪音在无情地啃噬着他的意志力。他的思绪陷入了极度的混乱，种族、吸引力、杀戮、狩猎……无数的问题如潮水般涌来，但只有寥寥几个得到了模糊的回答。这就是[独特]稀有度所带来的沉重负担。
-100生命值
然后她又听到了一声清脆的响声。
艾可的身体剧烈地颤抖着，难以想象的疼痛如汹涌的波涛在身体里肆意流淌。她的身体迅速肿胀，骨头嘎吱作响地伸展着。她的肌肉和皮肤因为无法容纳新的、更大的身体而无情地撕裂。艾可那原本柔顺的皮毛被鲜血浸染得鲜红，很快她就完全失去了对身体的感知。
-200生命值
她一动不动地躺在那里，新的骨头、肌肉和皮肤组织以惊人的速度生成，疼痛仍在无情地折磨着她脆弱的身体。
-1点生命力
她能清晰地感觉到生命力在大量地流失，因为身体里有个小小的神秘东西在缓缓形成，如此微小，然而……
-1点生命力
-1点生命力
-1点生命力
-1点生命力
生命力流失的速度快得惊人。系统完全没想到她这么快就达到了独特稀有度。它本应该引导她先经历一些相对平凡的稀有度，慢慢在食物链中逐步上升，但此刻控制它的人正在专心致志地制作一个新的鸡毛掸子，根本无暇顾及。
她的生命力急剧下降到了5点，但这一切还远远没有结束。她能感觉到生命的光芒在眼前飞速闪过，生命力慢慢降到了1点，但奇迹般地停在了那里。
content_en:
During this 25-day hunting trip, Echo never easily faced off against prey beyond his capabilities. He always chose an ambush. This was his way of survival. Despite this, he will occasionally provoke some enemies, and then cleverly use the "cave digging" skill to escape underground, confuse the opponent, and then kill them by surprise. Not only is this a great way for him to level up, it's also a strategy for his survival.
That night, he activated Sprint again. He managed his stamina just right and always kept it at full capacity, which allowed him to successfully upgrade his "stamina recovery" to level 3.
Aike also worked hard to upgrade "Health Recovery" to level 4. It was during this challenging journey that he experienced countless life-or-death moments, many times because of his overconfidence. A landslide brought his health to the brink of depletion. It was the first time he truly felt the serious impact of low health. His body became extremely heavy, his reflexes were sluggish, and his wounds left him extremely weak. As for endurance, it felt like being in a nightmare where he couldn't breathe, which greatly weakened his efficiency and physical coordination. Therefore, he always tries his best to maintain full health and stamina, never wanting to relive that terrifying feeling again.
However, what really frustrated him was that since leaving the village, his level had been stuck in a quagmire, always stagnant, and was still stuck at level 100. It seems that he must hunt more powerful beasts to be able to break this deadlock and further upgrade.
Still, the hardships paid off in the end, as he was just days away from success. During his long time in the forest, he also keenly noticed that the forest was becoming increasingly restless, and he encountered his companions several times during this period.
Every time I see the companion and its companions, they are always bruised and exhausted. The panther is always the least injured, but judging from its unique fur, it may also be a shadow hunter, which allows it to cleverly avoid head-on conflicts and naturally suffer less damage than its companions who directly face the enemy.
…
He happily ate some more eggs, and then returned to his cave with brisk steps. He was pleasantly surprised to realize that his "cave digging" skills could soften the ground, making it easier for him to "move" the soil away while digging. This discovery is undoubtedly a powerful addition to his excavation work. He can first use "Cave Digging" to soften the ground, and then "shovel" it away with his sharp claws.
Echo lay comfortably in his ever-expanding cave. However, a trace of worry crept into his mind. He was worried that if evolution made his body too big, he would be trapped in this small space.
Aike slowly lay down and waited patiently for the countdown to finally end. After that he planned to hunt for some fresh food. It takes about half a day to two days to digest these eggs, and he won't have much of a problem even if he doesn't eat for three days. There is a water source nearby, so drinking water is not a problem, but even so, it is absolutely impossible for him to go without water for five days. But he doesn't want to...
…
[Start the evolution process: [Shadow Fennec Fox]-0 days, 0 hours and 1 minute]
The time for evolution is coming. He waited impatiently, and beads of sweat appeared on his forehead. He noticed skill options like "Reduce Pain" or "Increase Pain Tolerance"... but they were prohibitively expensive.
Ai Ke had no choice but to grit his teeth and prepare to endure this heartbreaking pain.
[Evolution is ongoing]
"Ahhhhhhhhhhhh!"
When the strange sound rang in his ears, he was instantly tortured by unbearable pain and his mind went blank.
-100 studentshealth
"It's nice in the dark, right? You can kill anything you want and no one can find you~"
"It's a pleasure to be a woman, they pamper you so much, and even worship you when you're pretty enough. Imagine having everyone at your beck and call~"
"Just kill everyone who enters your territory. After all, it's yours!"
"You should enjoy your beauty and build a harem so that you don't need to hunt by yourself and just wait for the delicious and juicy meat to be delivered to you~"
"You should expand your territory so you can keep hunting! The hunting never stops!"
-100 health
There were all kinds of strange noises gnawing at his willpower mercilessly. His thoughts fell into extreme confusion. Race, attraction, killing, hunting... countless questions came flooding in, but only a few got vague answers. That's the heavy burden that comes with [unique] rarity.
-100 health
Then she heard another crisp sound.
Aike's body was shaking violently, and unimaginable pain flowed through his body like turbulent waves. Her body swelled rapidly, her bones creaking and stretching. Her muscles and skin tore apart mercilessly as they could no longer accommodate her new, larger body. Aike's originally soft fur was stained bright red with blood, and soon she completely lost all awareness of her body.
-200 health
She lay there motionless, new bones, muscles, and skin tissue forming at an alarming rate, and the pain was still tormenting her fragile body mercilessly.
-1 point of vitality
She could clearly feel that her vitality was losing a lot, because there was a small mysterious thing slowly forming in her body, so tiny, but...
-1 point of vitality
-1 point of vitality
-1 point of vitality
-1 point of vitality
The life force is lost at an alarming rate. The system didn't expect her to reach unique rarity so quickly. It should have guided her through some relatively mundane rarities first, and slowly moved up the food chain, but at the moment the person controlling it was concentrating on making a new feather duster and had no time to care.
Her vitality dropped sharply to 5 points, but this was far from over. She could feel the light of life flashing rapidly in front of her eyes. Her vitality slowly dropped to 1 point, but miraculously it stayed there.
